Title: App Service is now an events publisher on Azure Event Grid (in preview)

Body.Content:
Subscribe to events from your web app or app service plan and act on those events with handlers such as Functions, Logic Apps, and webhooks, or forward them to hybrid connections or a storage queue. This integration of App Service as an events publisher on Event Grid allows developers to:

  • Get greater visibility into their App Service deployment.
  • Apply event-driven patterns and architectures to App Service.

For more information, see the getting started guide and the list of integrated events.

For more information on Event Grid, read the documentation.
